prompt: Add a max_drawdown field to the backtest metrics output. It must be computed from the equity curve as the largest peak-to-trough percentage decline. Preserve existing metric names and output shape.
expected_failure_summary: compute_metrics omits max_drawdown; the field must be added without changing existing metric names.
task_author_notes: max_drawdown = max over t of (running_peak - equity_t) / running_peak, returned as a non-negative fraction. Monotonic-up curves yield 0.0.
